Defines package-level version metadata and Linux distribution name constants used throughout the application for OS detection and platform-specific logic.

## Key Components

**Variables**
- `Version` — Build-time application version string (defaults to empty, injected via linker flags)
- `Revision` — Git commit revision string, also injected at build time

**Distribution Family Constants**
| Constant | Value |
|---|---|
| `RedHat` | `"redhat"` |
| `CentOS` | `"centos"` |
| `Debian` | `"debian"` |
| `Ubuntu` | `"ubuntu"` |
| `Raspbian` | `"raspbian"` |
| `OpenSUSE` | `"opensuse"` |
| `Oracle` | `"oracle"` |
| `Alpine` | `"alpine"` |
| `Amazon` | `"amazon"` |
| `Fedora` | `"fedora"` |

**Ubuntu Codename Constants** — `trusty` through `plucky` (14.04–25.04)

**Debian Codename Constants** — `wheezy` through `trixie` (7–13)

## Usage Example

```go
import "github.com/flamingo-stack/fleetmdm/config"

// Version check at startup
fmt.Printf("fleetmdm %s (%s)\n", config.Version, config.Revision)

// OS-specific branching
func handleDistro(distro string) {
    switch distro {
    case config.Ubuntu, config.Debian, config.Raspbian:
        // APT-based logic
    case config.RedHat, config.CentOS, config.Fedora:
        // RPM-based logic
    case config.Alpine:
        // APK-based logic
    }
}

// Codename-specific handling
if release == config.Ubuntu2404 { // "noble"
    // Noble Numbat specific path
}
```

## Notes

- `Version` and `Revision` are typically set at build time via `-ldflags`:
  ```bash
  go build -ldflags "-X config.Version=1.2.3 -X config.Revision=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
  ```
- Source: [`config/config.go`](https://github.com/flamingo-stack/fleetmdm/blob/main/config/config.go)
